conviction_note: Two of TKP's three segments are consolidated with a two-month lag and their Apr-Jun quarters were already published by Lilycolor (OP -130m vs -258m) and On the Page (OP 770m, +19%) in August. Rebuilt from those, Q2 recurring profit lands at about 1.43bn yen against the 1.48bn the IFIS H1 consensus (3,850m) implies, which is in line and already in the price. Guidance is the only real swing: the plan looks beatable, but TKP has not revised at an H1 print in three years. So the findings net to +0.3 (impact_sum). The scaled number (-0.36) is slightly negative because the name has sold 7 of its 11 estimated prints, including a 31% Q1 consensus beat that fell 2.96% and last year's H1 at -10.7%. Lessons rule 1 keeps p_up near 50 (47). The two numbers differ in sign: the findings are near zero and the reaction history is the only lean.

findings.finding: Counterparty pre-release: TKP consolidates Lilycolor and On the Page with a two-month lag, so its Q2 (Jun-Aug) carries their Apr-Jun quarters, already published. Lilycolor OP is -130m vs -258m a year earlier (the TKP segment was -241m), and On the Page OP is 770m IFRS vs 645m (TKP segment 442m last year, about 200m below IFRS). With the core segment at +15% (its Q1 rate), Q2 OP comes to about 1.68bn and recurring profit to about 1.43bn, against roughly 1.48bn implied by consensus: a match to slightly short.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last H1 (2025-10-15) Q2 OP was 1,438m, +38%, but below a market view of over 1.5bn, and the stock fell more than 10% intraday (-10.74% in the baseline; https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3479&b=n202510160545). Q1 (2026-07-15) recurring profit beat IFIS by 31.4% and the stock fell 2.96% (baseline; https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/3479_20260715_act_20260715_153047_6).
findings.source_date: 2026-08-14 (On the Page Apr-Jun results); Lilycolor 2026-08-07 at https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=9827; TKP segment table and the two-month-lag seasonality slide at https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260715594513.pdf (2026-07-15)
findings.why_not_priced: It mostly is priced: both counterparty quarters have been public for two months, and an analyst rebuilding Q2 would land near the consensus implied number, which is roughly what I get. The residual uncertainty is the core segment (Jun-Aug is its weakest season, and hotel RevPAR was down 321 yen in Q1) and the IFRS-to-JGAAP adjustment on the merged wedding business. If the market expected a large beat or miss, the consensus implied Q2 would sit away from the rebuilt figure, and it does not.
findings.independence: Lilycolor (9827) and On the Page (9160) are separate issuers with separate filings. The core-segment estimate rests on TKP's own Q1 document. No independent series exists for the core (TKP publishes no monthly figures).

findings.finding: Guidance optionality: H1 recurring profit at about 3.8bn would be roughly 39% of the 9,700m plan, against 31% at the same point last year, and consensus (10,400m) already sits 7% above the plan. But TKP's revision record (kabutan) shows no revision at an H1 print in FY2024, FY2025 or FY2026. Revisions came at Q1 (2024-07-11), separately (2025-08-14, 2026-02-27) and at Q3 (2025-01-14, 2026-01-14). So a hold is the base case, with a minority chance of an upward revision at this print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 upward revision 2026-01-14: the stock rose four sessions running (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3479&b=n202601150317). Separate upward revision 2025-08-15: the stock jumped (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3479&b=n202508151263). The holds at H1 2025 and Q1 2026 were followed by falls of -10.7% and -3.0%.
findings.source_date: 2026-10-15 (revision-history table, accessed); FY plan held at https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260715594163.pdf (2026-07-15)
findings.why_not_priced: The street already models 10,400m against the 9,700m plan, so an upward revision would mostly confirm the consensus, and a hold is what the company's habit predicts. The small positive is the chance of a revision at this print, which a stock sitting 23% below its February high (2,425) with a consensus target of 3,240 is not pricing.
findings.independence: The kabuyoho/IFIS consensus (https://kabuyoho.jp/report?bcode=3479) and the MINKABU note that a research house sees OP at 12bn or more (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3479&b=n202607290433) point the same way on the plan being conservative. Neither says anything about timing.

baseline_tension: Nothing found cuts against the flat positioning (zero disclosed shorts, margin ratio 1.96, run-up +0.7%): the rebuilt quarter matches consensus. The strongest positive the release could carry is an upward revision of the plan the street already sits above (looked for: no pre-filed revision, and the company habit says Q3), and a buyback is unlikely after August's ¥3.5bn. The only directional content is the name's habit of selling prints, which keeps p_up just under 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a series the market already has): the reported-quarter finding rests on counterparty quarters public since August, so I shrank it from -0.3 to -0.2 and moved p_up from 45 to 47.
Rule 2 (check the sign): the strongest positive (revision, buyback) is written into baseline_tension. I had already looked for it, so no further move. The guidance finding (+0.5) is unchanged.
